import sys

MOD = 998244353

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])
    l = int(data[2])
    r = int(data[3])
    k = n * m
    len_ = r - l + 1

    if k % 2 == 1:
        ans = pow(len_, k, MOD)
    else:
        ans = (pow(len_, k, MOD) + pow(len_ % 2, k, MOD)) * pow(2, MOD - 2, MOD) % MOD
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
